title: Rust lacks static X25519-from-Ed25519-seed derivation required by spec 8.5/8.7/8.9 (Python/C implement and match vectors)
description: Requirement (spec/06-security.md:112,146,461-466): x25519_priv = clamp(SHA-512(seed)[0:32]) for OSCORE/EDHOC; Clamping per RFC 7748 section 5 is REQUIRED; part of the normative derivation that MUST match test vectors exactly. Classification: implemented+tested (Python identity.py:97-110 with test/vectors/x25519.json clamping vectors; C edhoc_crypto.c:287-307 x25519_keypair_from_seed with explicit clamp); not-implemented (Rust — no static derivation anywhere under rust/; rust/oscore-fork EDHOC uses ephemeral-only X25519, edhoc/initiator.rs:30,48 and edhoc/responder.rs:30,46). Suggested placement: rust identity or edhoc glue layer. human-only: EDHOC-adjacent decision — spec allows ephemeral-ephemeral DH (L469) but also mandates the seed-derived static key; whether the Rust profile intentionally omits static derivation is a human call. Do not plan a fix without that decision.
